animations.name: marquee
animations.css: @keyframes marquee { 0% { transform: translateX(0); } 100% { transform: translateX(calc(-100% - var(--marquee-gap))); } }
animations.description: Continuous horizontal scroll animation for the customer logo strip in the hero section

animations.name: passport-glow-ellipse-x
animations.css: @keyframes passport-glow-ellipse-x { from { transform: scaleX(1); } to { transform: scaleX(1.5); } }
animations.description: Scaling animation for decorative glow effect on the Passport feature card

animations.name: accordion-down
animations.css: @keyframes accordion-down { from { height: 0; } to { height: var(--radix-accordion-content-height); } }
animations.description: Expand animation for accordion content panels

animations.name: accordion-up
animations.css: @keyframes accordion-up { from { height: var(--radix-accordion-content-height); } to { height: 0; } }
animations.description: Collapse animation for accordion content panels

animations.name: fade-in
animations.description: Simple fade in animation used for page elements and hero content

animations.name: fade-slide-in
animations.css: @keyframes fade-slide-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
animations.description: Combined fade and slide animation for scroll reveal elements

animations.name: button-transition
animations.css: transition: border-color 150ms ease-in-out, background 150ms ease-in-out, color 150ms ease-in-out, transform 150ms ease-in-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-in-out
animations.description: Standard button hover and focus transition token

animations.name: card-hover-transform
animations.description: Card scale and rotation transform on hover for feature cards

animations.name: hero-text-scramble
animations.description: JS-driven text scramble animation cycling through taglines in the hero section

animations.name: opacity-transition
animations.description: Standard opacity transition for element visibility changes

insights: The design uses a high-contrast monochromatic palette with black (#171717) and white (#FFFFFF) as primary interaction colors, creating strong visual hierarchy for CTAs.
Button system has two distinct radius patterns: rounded-full (pill) for hero/marketing CTAs and rounded-md (6px) for navigation/utility buttons, establishing clear context differentiation.
Motion design is restrained but purposeful, with subtle 150ms transitions for micro-interactions and longer 300ms transforms for card hovers, creating a polished professional feel.
